checks: Confirm review window (2026-09-01 to 2026-11-30) and that the last IDT review date is documented so changes are measured from the correct baseline.
Falls: count any falls, near-falls, or fall-related injuries in the window, with circumstances, and whether a fall-risk reassessment or care-plan update followed.
ED visits and hospital admissions in the window: dates, reasons, discharge summaries, and whether follow-up appointments were completed.

Infection surveillance given sepsis history (onset 1996): check for fevers, new infections, antibiotic courses, urinary or respiratory symptoms, and any sepsis-related ED visits or readmissions; confirm vaccination status is current as documented.
Cardiac status for ischemic heart disease: chest pain or nitroglycerin spray use (frequency and dates), new dyspnea, edema, palpitations, and any cardiology visits, ECGs, or testing in the window.

Antiplatelet and cardiac medication review: confirm clopidogrel, metoprolol succinate, simvastatin, and nitroglycerin spray are still active and taken as prescribed; check refill gaps, missed doses, any new starts or stops, and any bleeding or bruising events on clopidogrel.
Lipid and related lab follow-up on simvastatin: check whether recent lipid panel or liver enzymes are due or overdue and whether results were reviewed.
Blood pressure and heart rate trend in the window, including orthostatic readings and any low readings on metoprolol, flagged against the team's thresholds.
Weight and BMI trend (obesity, BMI 30+): compare most recent weight with prior values, note any unintended gain or loss, and check whether a nutrition or activity referral is documented as due.
Glycemic and metabolic screening appropriate to obesity and cardiac disease, if labs are on file: check whether monitoring is due and whether results are documented.

Function and ADLs/IADLs: compare current status with the last review across bathing, dressing, toileting, transfers, continence, meal preparation, medication management, and transportation; note any decline and whether therapy or equipment was requested.

Cognition, mood, and sleep: screen for changes since last review, including depression or anxiety screening scores, any delirium signs during prior infections, and attendance or engagement in PACE programming.
Attendance at PACE center and adult day programming, transportation issues, and missed appointments in the window.

Caregiver and social situation: any change in primary caregiver, living arrangement, caregiver strain, financial or housing concerns, and advance directive or health-care proxy status (participant lives in Los Angeles; confirm contact details are current).
Care-plan items due: list goals, interventions, and reassessments with due dates falling in or before the review date (2026-11-30), and mark which are complete, overdue, or need IDT discussion.
Allergy record: allergies list is empty; confirm with participant and pharmacy that no allergies are present and that the record reflects this accurately before the meeting.

Summarize findings as changes since last review for the IDT to discuss, without making treatment recommendations; flag items needing clinician decision (for example antiplatelet plus statin plan, BP/HR changes, infection or ED events).
